title: Narrow with two filters
hook: Four files match one clue. Which one matches both?

knows: reading short labels and comparing simple counts

claims.text: Scenario, hook and prediction: Four files match one clue. Which one matches both? What does adding an owner filter to PDF mean? Correct option: Both conditions. All fixture labels, example words, dates, task durations and file fields are stipulated exercise data.

claims.text: Combining these two filters requires both fields to match. The fixture counts the intersection, rather than adding the two result sets.
